caller_inventory.FridaRuntimeProbe: start runtime; reserve two managers; start both; reject runtime close; close first twice; start/close third; close reserved unstarted; global close; reject reinit
caller_inventory.FridaScriptProbe: start runtime; reserve/start manager; reserve/attach sessions; cleanup scripts before sessions before manager before runtime
caller_inventory.AllocationHook: consumes caller-owned acquired manager; owns sessions/scripts but does not start or close manager

tdd.constraint: The defect is an external native lifecycle failure established by accepted native C/GDB receipts; original control does not reproduce on this WSL host. A real Java native runner is prohibited before review. No claim of a local behavioral red or native pass. No mutable test-only seam will be introduced.
tdd.verification: focused existing Java ownership guards and package/class identity; later native Java consumer required

patch.post_compile_edit: Only Manager.start Javadoc was clarified after compilation. No executable tokens changed; no repeated compilation for that documentation edit.

native_abi.GError: Separate fresh zero-initialized ADDRESS slot for enumeration, local lookup and close; existing NativeFailure copies domain/code/message then disposes once
native_abi.owned_successful_list: Stored immediately, frida_unref called once after successful enumeration, pointer cleared only when release returns; an uncertain release is retained and never retried by close.

failure_guarantees.primary: Manager.start catches only to retain its original failure for later cleanup diagnosis, then rethrows the same object. No automatic retry.
failure_guarantees.guard: acquiring OR native handle with incomplete startup OR retained enumeration list refuses all native close/unrefs and retains manager registration. Repeat close reports retained failure.
failure_guarantees.null_manager: A definitive NULL manager return owns no native handle; close can release the Java reservation without calling native close.
failure_guarantees.uncertain_enum_failure: No claim that ordinary manager.close/unref/global shutdown is safe; retained ownership is intentional, not reported as successful cleanup.
failure_guarantees.unsupported_result: A nonnull list plus fresh nonnull GError is not a supported result from the pinned public operation; candidate conservatively retains any recorded pointer and manager instead of claiming cleanup.

design_checks.minimum: ordinary successful enumeration establishes close boundary
design_checks.analogous: accepted full enumeration followed by supported missing-ID error allows distinct fresh-error cleanup
design_checks.dissimilar: resource-free manager reservation or definitive NULL new-manager result needs no startup before Java registration release
design_checks.invariant: Native cleanup requires confirmed full startup and resolved owned enumeration result; lack of acquired native resources remains resource-free.
design_checks.test_boundary: No new mutable seam, reflection, fixture library or alternative lifecycle implementation added.

remaining_native_consumer_gate.normal: Run actual compiled FridaRuntimeProbe in fresh JVM on free retained native Linux x64 worker with exact accepted .so and module-only native-access grant. Require three successful manager starts, independent closure, global refusal with remaining owners, cleanup/global shutdown returned, second init rejected; then one fresh-process verification with identical artifacts.
remaining_native_consumer_gate.owner_composition: Re-run only previously blocked retained-owner native case with exact corrected five-file owner candidate plus this reviewed Runtime candidate; prove actual populated-zero -> hooks close -> COLLECT -> root/adopted statuses. No production acceptance from C startup proof alone.
remaining_native_consumer_gate.pre_full_start_failure_guard: A practical supported deterministic enum-start failure consumer is not established. No natural Frida full-start failure or failed-acquisition cleanup acceptance is claimed; production guard and ownership retention need direct Java behavioral evidence before declaring that gate passed.
remaining_native_consumer_gate.post_full_start_lookup_failure: C proof covers supported missing-ID branch only; production Java currently selects local by type. Do not silently treat missing-ID proof as actual unavailable-local proof.
remaining_native_consumer_gate.other_platforms: Windows/macOS native FFM startup/close not validated by this Linux-specific receipt.
